summary_en: This Phase II study tests larotrectinib, a drug taken by mouth, in people aged 16 or older with NTRK gene amplification-positive solid tumors that are locally advanced or metastatic. The study drug is taken twice a day on days 1 to 28 of each 28-day cycle, and cycles repeat in the absence of unacceptable toxicity. The record does not state the main outcome measure; the study is Phase II.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase II evalúa larotrectinib, un medicamento que se toma por vía oral, en personas de 16 años o más con tumores sólidos localmente avanzados o metastásicos que tienen amplificación del gen NTRK. El medicamento se toma dos veces al día los días 1 a 28 de cada ciclo de 28 días, y los ciclos se repiten si no hay toxicidad inaceptable. El registro no indica la medida de resultado principal; el estudio es de fase II.
who_for: Locally advanced or metastatic solid tumor with NTRK1, NTRK2, or NTRK3 gene amplification of at least 7 copies.
Prior standard therapy for the tumor type and stage, or unlikely to tolerate or benefit from standard care.
At least one measurable lesion by RECIST v1.1.
ECOG score of 3 or less, with archived tumor tissue or an attempted biopsy.
not_for: Prior disease progression on an approved or investigational TRK inhibitor.
Symptomatic or unstable brain metastases that need corticosteroids.
Uncontrolled second cancer that would limit assessment of study results.
Uncontrolled infection, unstable heart disease, heart attack or stroke within 3 months.
Pregnancy or lactation, or inability to stop strong CYP450 or CYP3A4 inhibitors or inducers.
